statement: Put g = (d − 1)(k − 1) + 1d=4, δ1(U, V ) = max{U/2, min(U, V/g)}. Fix a degree bound E, and let C be a geometrically irreducible curve of degree at most E, defined over Q, in the arithmetic variety ak i bi = n − θi in the coordinates just described. For every ε > 0, either |S ∩ C| ≪f,E,ε Xε , or its filtered Hilbert dimension, with weight U on x′ and weight V on y′, satisfies HC(T) ≥ T δ1(U, V ) − Of,E(1). (9.2) 36 The implied constants may also depend on a fixed compact subset of (0, ∞) containing U, V . They are otherwise uniform in the weights and in the integral coordinate changes. In particular they are uniform for the weights arising from Proposition 6.2.
